intent: Write the test for TelemetrySample (context telemetry-ingestion-processing) at the test file path; the unit under test lives at src/main/java/com/pulsestream/telemetry/validation/domain/TelemetrySample.java. Assert only against the tabled surface. Telemetry Sample value record: one 1Hz data point. Components: deviceId, metric (one of heart_rate, power, cadence, ground_contact_time, respiration, swim_stroke, swim_pace), tDevice (device timestamp, the only chronological ordering key), tIngress (arrival time, never an ordering key), value, status (PENDING before validation, VALID, or VALIDATION_FAILED; the payload is kept when invalid), correlationId (explicit carriage of the request correlation id through the pipeline). Immutable: withStatus and withIngress return a copy with only that component replaced. Public String constants STATUS_PENDING="PENDING", STATUS_VALID="VALID", STATUS_VALIDATION_FAILED="VALIDATION_FAILED". TEST DUTIES: Assert accessors, that withStatus/withIngress return a new equal-except-one-component record leaving the original unchanged, and the three status constants.

methods.signature: TelemetrySample(String deviceId, String metric, Instant tDevice, Instant tIngress, double value, String status, String correlationId)
